items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That was an enjoyable and unique experience. I appreciated Chet for what he was doing then.

ctx.x: What’s your overall . . . actually, we never talked about [if] we go back to fifty-three, the records you made with Mulligan’s quartet with Chet.
That was an enjoyable and unique experience. I appreciated Chet for what he was doing then. Certainly [I] was pleased with Gerry for including me in that.
